description: Returns the FIPS 140-3 status of one product version from NIST CMVP data: ACTIVE, EXPIRING (sunset within 180 days), HISTORICAL, IN_QUEUE (NIST in-process or lab Implementation Under Test list), NOT_VALIDATED or UNVERIFIED, with certificate numbers, sunset dates, post-quantum algorithms and links to the NIST pages used (receipts). The answer is fail-closed: if NIST data is stale it says UNVERIFIED rather than ACTIVE. A few free lookups per day; after that, either set SCOUTWYZE_API_KEY (prepaid credits) or the tool returns an HTTP 402 with an x402 USDC-on-Base challenge that a wallet-capable agent must pay and retry with X-PAYMENT. This server cannot pay it. Unmapped products return 404 with the known list and are always free. Not legal or compliance advice.
name: fips_lookup
title: ScoutWyze FIPS: is this version FIPS 140-3 validated?
